title: Apple & cinnamon protein porridge
method: Add the oats, milk, apple and cinnamon to a saucepan.
Cook over a medium-low heat for 5–6 minutes, stirring regularly, until thick and the apple has softened.
Take off the heat and stir through half the yoghurt.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the remaining yoghurt and measured peanut butter.

substitutions.note: Use a peanut-free option if required.
Choose one appropriate to your dietary needs.

storage.chilled: If made ahead, cool promptly and refrigerate in a covered container for up to 24 hours.
storage.reheat: Reheat until steaming hot throughout; loosen with a splash of milk if needed.

food_safety: Refrigerate yoghurt and milk until needed.

title: Egg, bean & salsa breakfast burrito
method: Warm the beans in a small pan until piping hot.
Beat the eggs and scramble them gently in a non-stick frying pan until fully set.
Lay out the wrap and add spinach, beans, egg, salsa and cheese.
Fold in the sides, roll tightly and toast seam-side down in a dry pan for 1–2 minutes.

storage.chilled: If preparing components ahead, refrigerate cooked egg and beans promptly and use within 24 hours.
storage.reheat: Reheat cooked components until steaming hot before assembling.

food_safety: Cook eggs until no liquid egg remains.
Keep cooked egg chilled if not eating immediately.

title: Chicken Caesar-style pitta
method: Mix the yoghurt, lemon juice, mustard and half the parmesan.
Slice the chicken and toss it with the lettuce and dressing.
Warm the pitta if you like, then split it carefully.
Stuff with the chicken mixture and finish with the remaining parmesan.

storage.chilled: Keep chicken and dressing refrigerated; assemble just before eating where possible.
storage.reheat: Do not repeatedly reheat previously cooked chicken.

food_safety: Use cooked chicken that has been stored safely and is within its use-by period.

title: Tuna, sweetcorn & pesto pasta pot
method: Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions until tender.
Drain and cool promptly if making a cold lunch.
Mix the pasta with tuna, sweetcorn, tomatoes and pesto.
Fold through the rocket just before eating.

substitutions.note: Use an equivalent cooked portion if fish is not suitable.
Check nut, milk and other allergen labels.

storage.chilled: Refrigerate promptly and use within 24 hours.
storage.reheat: Designed to be eaten cold; if warming it, heat thoroughly and only once.

food_safety: Keep tuna refrigerated after opening and discard leftovers not promptly chilled.

title: Turkey meatball tomato orzo
method: Shape the turkey mince into small meatballs with damp hands.
Heat the oil over medium heat and brown the meatballs for 5–6 minutes, turning carefully.
Add onion and courgette and cook for 3 minutes, then add garlic and oregano for 30 seconds.
Stir in tomatoes, orzo and enough water to keep the orzo just covered.
Simmer for 10–12 minutes, stirring regularly, until the orzo is tender and the turkey is completely cooked through.

substitutions.note: Cook thoroughly and check the centre of the meatballs.
Adjust liquid and cooking time to the packet instructions.

storage.chilled: Cool promptly, refrigerate in a covered container and use within 2 days.
storage.freeze: Freeze a suitable portion once completely cool.
storage.reheat: Defrost safely if frozen and reheat until steaming hot throughout; only reheat once.

food_safety: Turkey meatballs must be completely cooked through with no pink centre.

title: Lemon chicken, roast potatoes & greens
method: Heat the oven to 210°C/190°C fan.
Toss the potatoes with half the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Rub the chicken with the remaining oil, garlic, thyme and lemon zest, then add it to the tray.
Roast for 18–20 minutes more until the chicken is completely cooked and the potatoes are tender.
Steam or microwave the broccoli and beans until tender, then serve with a squeeze of lemon.

substitutions.note: Cook fully through; timing may vary with thickness.
Cut evenly and cook until tender.

storage.chilled: Cool leftovers promptly, refrigerate and use within 2 days.
storage.reheat: Reheat chicken and potatoes until steaming hot throughout; only reheat once.

food_safety: Chicken must be completely cooked through before serving.

title: Easy chicken & spinach curry
method: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Heat the oil in a pan and cook the onion for 4–5 minutes.
Add the chicken and curry paste and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10–12 minutes until the chicken is completely cooked.
Stir through spinach until wilted, take off the heat and fold in the yoghurt. Divide into two portions with the rice.

substitutions.note: Dice evenly and cook completely through.
Check suitability for cooking and labels.

storage.chilled: Cool the spare curry and rice rapidly, refrigerate separately if possible and use within 2 days.
storage.freeze: Freeze the cooled curry; freshly cooked rice is preferable when serving later.
storage.reheat: Reheat curry until steaming hot throughout; only reheat once.

food_safety: Chicken must be fully cooked through.
Cool cooked rice rapidly and refrigerate promptly.

title: Peach, yoghurt & oat crunch pot
method: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl or pot.
Top with sliced peach and measured oats.
Finish with cinnamon and eat straight away or keep chilled until needed.

substitutions.note: Check the nutrition and allergen label.

storage.chilled: Keep refrigerated and use within 24 hours if assembled ahead.
